limitations: Rooted, fully binary ultrametric trees with positive lengths and one uniform independent extinction risk; fixed focal taxa and topology.
No asserted empirical prevalence, full-ranking reversal, or extension to taxon-dependent extinction probabilities.
Prior coverage search is finite and independent scholarly validation is outstanding.
scientific_integrity: The rooted equal-extinction-risk HED formula originates with Steel, Mimoto and Mooers; only the sharp small-tree priority-switch threshold and exact construction are assessed as the finding. Rational finite checks corroborate rather than substitute for proof.
source_ids: Kerry Manson, Mathematical aspects of phylogenetic diversity measures, University of Canterbury thesis
title: Sharp seven-taxon onset of repeated HED priority reversals
